strengths: Real Topbar switch click is the UI entry point in Cycle 1 and Cycle 2 — matches spec's goal-level affordance without mocking the component.

All three story acceptance criteria (analytics non-empty, GeoMap 40–60 bbox, order→payment→invoice side-effects) are verified against real loader functions and real Zustand store — no stubs for system-under-test.

Zero-network invariant asserted across 31 guarded call-sites (≥25 target met) in a single expect(fetchMock).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(0) covering analytics, DI, operations, admin, sales, and page loaders.
Determinism across toggle cycles (ON→OFF→ON) properly verified with toEqual deep-equal comparison and fixed-today injection via setDummyGenerator — no Date.now() in assertions.
Ephemerality proven: after toggle OFF, dummyEntities is null and subsequent loadAnalytics triggers real fetchMock calls.
Sweep test dynamically imports all guarded modules from actual module paths — every import resolves to real exports.
Clean lifecycle: beforeEach resets store + seeds localStorage + stubs fetch; afterEach restores global.fetch and resets store.

Refresh persistence Critical fixed: pre-mutation snapshot captured via JSON deep-clone before mutation and asserted with toEqual after both isolated-module regeneration and main-store re-init; readPersistedFlag() creation path exercised via jest.isolateModules fresh require (bc951fe); redundant localStorage seeding removed.

issues.description: Test file is 429 lines (was 414), exceeding the ~300-line refactor heuristic. Justified as a comprehensive cross-unit integration test with 4 scenarios (analytics/GeoMap/finance/order + refresh/re-fetch + zero-network sweep + determinism), shared setup, and helpers — but the implementer may want to split into per-cycle files if the file continues to grow.
